source: Book IV printed pp.73-74 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.79-80 (modification, rule and procedure), base wiring printed p.72 = PDF p.78 (Experiment 1, 44 wires), image-read; Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect is derived by hand from the 50-wire topology and the p.73 rule 'If slide switch 6 is LEFT, the counter will count UP; if slide switch 6 is RIGHT, the counter will count DOWN.', not from printed answers, and is tagged FALLBACK-DERIVED-TOPOLOGY. Wiring: the page's remove/add modification of Experiment 1 (printed p.73 = PDF p.79) applied to the 44-wire list of printed p.72 = PDF p.78, 44 - 2 + 8 = 50, the same list as IV-EXP3; programs.json wiresEffective is still null (tools EFFECTIVE_UNRESOLVED), so the hand-resolved list from the Step 7 notes is used. ER-22 applies only to the alternate counter and is not applied. Checkpoints: count 0 at power-on; 7 after the printed seven UP pushes; each DOWN push 6, 5, 4 and 3 at rest (the Step 7 notes' derivation-worthy case, light 5 off at 5 against the p.71 chart row 11 misprint); the fourth DOWN push held, where the borrow runs through both stages; 3 + 1 = 4 after slide switch 6 goes back LEFT, which separates UP from DOWN; 0 after four more DOWN pushes; 7 after one DOWN push from 0 (the three-bit wrap). The DOWN path, unlike the printed endpoints, separates 7 - 4 from 7 + 4. Lamps asserted: lights 4-6 everywhere, and the E-node output lamp and both indicator lamps of each flip-flop at 0 (no current); lit indicator lamps and lit outLamp1-3 share coil current and are not asserted. Script choices, not printed: count 0 from power-on rather than a carried-over counter; each push, release and switch move is followed by settle 500 ms and a 200 ms advance (the slow pace of IV-EXP1-DERIVED); release steps carry the counter collapse tag; the page prints no timing.

derived from the 50-wire topology (Experiment 1's 44 wires minus 3J/6K and 1J/4K, plus 3K/6W 3N/4N 6R/6K 4K/6U 5N/6N 5K/6T 6S/3J 6V/1J): 1C..6C on minus (6C/6-), each coil runs nF-coil-nE-indicator lamp-minus; flip-flop A = relays 1/2 (1G +, 1H=1F=2F=4A light 4, 1E=2G, input 1J=2H=6V, 2E=2J=1A light 1), B = relays 3/4 (3G +, 3H=3F=4F=5A light 5, 3E=4G, input 3J=4H=3N=4N=6S, 4E=4J=2A light 2), C = relays 5/6 (5G +, 5H=5F=6F=6A light 6, 5E=6G, input P=6X=5J=6H=5N=6N, 6E=6J=3A light 3); pushbutton 6 puts + on P (6Y/6+); a stage at 1 has both relays in (odd relay latched by nG-nH), at 0 both out with every node floating; + on a stage input toggles it while held (0: odd relay pulls in through nJ-nH, even relay held out with + on both coil ends; 1: odd relay dropped by + on nE through the even relay's nH-nG) and the even relay follows on release; carry nodes 5L=6L (fed from P by 5N with relay 5 out or 6N with relay 6 out) and 3L=4L (fed from the B input by 3N with relay 3 out or 4N with relay 4 out); slide switch 6 set 1 (arm 6S, LEFT 6R=6K, RIGHT 6T=5K) and set 2 (arm 6V, LEFT 6U=4K, RIGHT 6W=3K): LEFT carries C to B on 5N-5L-6L-6K-6R-6S-3J (relay 5 out, 6 in: C falling 1 to 0) and B to A on 3N-3L-4L-4K-6U-6V-1J (relay 3 out, 4 in), so UP is Experiment 1; RIGHT carries C to B on 6N-6L-5L-5K-6T-6S-3J (relay 5 in, 6 out: C rising 0 to 1, a borrow) and B to A on 4N-4L-3L-3K-6W-6V-1J (relay 3 in, 4 out), so each push subtracts 1 modulo 8; the unused route's K contact dead-ends on the open switch throw; light n+3 is flip-flop A/B/C, ON = 1; at power-on + reaches the counter only at 1G, 3G, 5G (open N.O. contacts) and 6Y (pushbutton up, 6Z unwired), so no coil, lamp or carry node has a source: all six relays out, all twelve lamps dark

not printed); derived from the 50-wire topology (Experiment 1's 44 wires minus 3J/6K and 1J/4K, plus 3K/6W 3N/4N 6R/6K 4K/6U 5N/6N 5K/6T 6S/3J 6V/1J): 1C..6C on minus (6C/6-), each coil runs nF-coil-nE-indicator lamp-minus; flip-flop A = relays 1/2 (1G +, 1H=1F=2F=4A light 4, 1E=2G, input 1J=2H=6V, 2E=2J=1A light 1), B = relays 3/4 (3G +, 3H=3F=4F=5A light 5, 3E=4G, input 3J=4H=3N=4N=6S, 4E=4J=2A light 2), C = relays 5/6 (5G +, 5H=5F=6F=6A light 6, 5E=6G, input P=6X=5J=6H=5N=6N, 6E=6J=3A light 3); pushbutton 6 puts + on P (6Y/6+); a stage at 1 has both relays in (odd relay latched by nG-nH), at 0 both out with every node floating; + on a stage input toggles it while held (0: odd relay pulls in through nJ-nH, even relay held out with + on both coil ends; 1: odd relay dropped by + on nE through the even relay's nH-nG) and the even relay follows on release; carry nodes 5L=6L (fed from P by 5N with relay 5 out or 6N with relay 6 out) and 3L=4L (fed from the B input by 3N with relay 3 out or 4N with relay 4 out); slide switch 6 set 1 (arm 6S, LEFT 6R=6K, RIGHT 6T=5K) and set 2 (arm 6V, LEFT 6U=4K, RIGHT 6W=3K): LEFT carries C to B on 5N-5L-6L-6K-6R-6S-3J (relay 5 out, 6 in: C falling 1 to 0) and B to A on 3N-3L-4L-4K-6U-6V-1J (relay 3 out, 4 in), so UP is Experiment 1; RIGHT carries C to B on 6N-6L-5L-5K-6T-6S-3J (relay 5 in, 6 out: C rising 0 to 1, a borrow) and B to A on 4N-4L-3L-3K-6W-6V-1J (relay 3 in, 4 out), so each push subtracts 1 modulo 8; the unused route's K contact dead-ends on the open switch throw; light n+3 is flip-flop A/B/C, ON = 1; DOWN steps: 4 to 3 borrows through B into A (as the fourth DOWN push), 3 to 2 is C 1 to 0 alone, 2 to 1 borrows from C into B (B 1 to 0, no borrow onward), 1 to 0 is C 1 to 0 alone; at 0 every node is floating: all relays out, all twelve lamps dark
